data.title: OKF-L400-S0: Socratic Grilling & Prompting for Multi-Agent Systems — Master Google Open Knowledge Framework (OKF v0.2) Authoritative Reference
data.description: Master L400 architectural synthesis of Socratic Grilling and Prompting across Agent-Grills-User interactive inquiry topologies (KELE, Socratic Students, CRIT/Chang) and Agent-Grills-Agent dialectical verification, temporal planning, recursive decomposition, and reference-free autorater pipelines (HDE, MACI, Recursive Socratic Questioning, SoDa, SOCREVAL, ODQS), mapped to Google Cloud ADK 2.0, A2A v0.3, Spanner Graph, and Vertex AI.
